name: Lucien Aubert
want: get the family at the presbytery to Switzerland and keep the letter box safe
voice: Unhurried, Lyonnais, says less than he knows.
description: Runs the looms of a small silk workshop above the bookshop and carries messages for the movement on his rounds to the mills. Knows every traboule on the slopes.
appearance: Lean, with a worker's cap, rolled sleeves, silk lint on his trousers and a bicycle clip still on one ankle.
